parsed.explanation: The division itself is protective: gender-identity discrimination is enforceable through a human-relations commission that investigates and awards damages; licenses offer X markers; the largest city mandates gender-neutral bathrooms and shields gender-affirming care travellers; the governor vetoed a school-sports ban; no facility ban, no criminalisation of expression, and an independent assessment grades it low-risk. Those operate only at the sub-national layer. Above it, the parent regime is the operative exposure: sex-as-assigned-at-birth document rules took effect in November 2025, entry screening can refuse cases on sex discrepancy and contemplate permanent fraud ineligibility, trans athletes are barred entry, trans and nonbinary travellers report passports blocked or stranded, and national immigration custody shows documented denial of hormones, forced labour and sexual abuse. Courts still function and a national gender-identity hate-crime statute exists, but the statewide hate-crime provision was struck down. The border and custody exposures travel with every visitor and the division cannot offset them.
